Dengan kekuatan baru yang tak terkalahkan, ia memulai perjuangan untuk menghancurkan kekuasaan Raja Lich yang menguasai dunia Murim dengan cara kejam. Dalam perjalanan penuh bahaya dan pertarungan epik, sang Demon menghadapi berbagai musuh berbahaya dan berusaha mengembalikan kedamaian di dunia Murim. Cerita ini menampilkan perpaduan antara aksi yang intens dan strategi pertempuran yang cerdas, membuat pembaca terbawa dalam setiap langkah sang pahlawan.
sinopsis_en: An unknown voice disturbed me while I was levitating during my cultivation to reach the transcendent demonic state. My concentration had been broken, and I fell into an unconscious, overloaded state. When I awoke a month later, the Lich King had already taken control of the Murim. After the battle that ended with the destruction of the Heavenly Demon Cult, I awoke a hundred and forty years later in a Murim where magic and martial arts coexisted. **Original Webtoon:** [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/57164369), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%B2%9C%EB%A7%88,%20%EB%A6%AC%EC%B9%98%EC%99%95%EC%9D%98%20%EB%AC%B4%EB%A6%BC%EB%A5%BC%20%EB%B6%80%EC%88%98%EB%8B%A4/2583) **Official Translations:** [Japanese](https://piccoma.com/web/product/95136), [S.Chinese](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/12773/)

sinopsis_id: Komik ini mengisahkan tentang seorang pewaris muda keluarga Baek yang menderita penyakit kronis serius. Meski menghadapi berbagai tantangan kesehatan, ia berusaha keras untuk membuktikan dirinya dan menjaga kehormatan keluarga. Dalam perjalanannya, dia menghadapi berbagai konflik internal dan eksternal yang menguji tekad serta kekuatan mentalnya. Seiring waktu berjalan, protagonis belajar untuk menerima kondisinya sambil menemukan arti sebenarnya dari kekuatan dan cinta. sinopsis_en: Baek Yigang is a son of the Baek Clan, one of the seven great clans of Zhongyuan. Afflicted with the Taiyin Qi Blockage, he is cursed with a shortened lifespan and the inability to collect internal energy. He had been peacefully spending the rest of his days indoors when he was ambushed by a group of masked people. During the ambush, he lost his servant who was like a sister to him. Chased by the attackers, Baek Yigang escaped through a secret underground path. When he came across a blocked path, he decided he’d at least die fighting and picked up a rusted sword that was stuck in the ground… [Original Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=8174581) **Original Webtoon:** [Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=814535), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10044728) **Official Translations:** [Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/fantasy/the-baek-clans-sickly-young-master/list?title_no=5856), [S.Chinese](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/BOY/wulinshijiajuezhenggongzi/list?title_no=2676), [T.Chinese](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/martial-arts/the-baek-clans-sickly-young-master/list?title_no=5891), [French](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/fantasy/the-baek-clans-sickly-young-master/list?title_no=6057), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003309)

sinopsis_id: seorang tokoh utama yang diberikan kesempatan kedua untuk hidup dengan kecerdasan luar biasa setelah mengalami tragedi besar. Dengan kemampuan jeniusnya, dia mencoba mengubah nasib dan memecahkan berbagai masalah yang sebelumnya tidak bisa dia atasi. Namun, waktu yang dimilikinya sangat terbatas sehingga setiap langkah harus penuh pertimbangan. sinopsis_en: Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny. **Original Novel:** [Munpia](https://novel.munpia.com/229405), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.nhn?productNo=5896155) **Original Webtoon:** [Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=832703), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11659054) **Official Translations:** [English](https://www.webtoons.com/en/action/chronicles-of-a-doomed-prodigy/list?title_no=7408), [T.Chinese](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/martial-arts/chronicles-of-a-doomed-prodigy/list?title_no=7164), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003704)

sinopsis_id: Phantom Spirit King mengisahkan seorang remaja yang secara tak sengaja terlibat dalam dunia roh setelah menemukan artefak kuno. Ia pun mendapatkan kemampuan supranatural untuk berkomunikasi dan mengendalikan roh, yang membawanya ke berbagai petualangan penuh misteri dan bahaya. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, ia harus menghadapi berbagai musuh dan mengungkap rahasia kelam tentang asal-usul kekuatannya. Sambil berusaha melindungi orang-orang yang dicintainya, ia juga belajar tentang tanggung jawab dan arti keberanian sejati dalam menghadapi dunia gaib yang penuh teka-teki.
sinopsis_en: What if the world was divided into people with martial arts powers and people without? Taeyeon Kang was one of the lucky few born with such powers. He enrolls in Murim Police University, a special school for those with powers to stand on the side of justice… but he has a secret of his own. He’s here to uncover the truth behind his father’s disappearance as well as seek protection from the Evil Murim Faction which is after his family’s secret book of martial arts techniques. At the same time, the legendary Ghost King makes his grand return, years after his mysterious disappearance. Just who is this masked anti-hero? In a world where the Murim world of the past continued on to modern day… After the killer ‘Phantom Spirit King’ disappeared without a trace, the Murim spent its days peacefully. One day, a drug that enhances the inner strength of Martial Artists appeared, and just in time, the ‘Phantom Spirit King’ who had disappeared showed himself. Then, the Murim that was peaceful plunged into the vortex of chaos once again.. **Original Webtoon:** [Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=784837), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6754777) **Official Translations:** [English](https://www.webtoons.com/en/action/ghost-king/list?title_no=4005), [S.Chinese](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/BOY/guilingwang/list?title_no=2007), [French](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/action/ghost-king/list?title_no=3674), [German](https://www.webtoons.com/de/action/ghost-king/list?title_no=4574), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0001776)

sinopsis_id: Aku mencapai kehidupan nyamanku sebagai pegawai negeri kelas tujuh dengan melalui banyak kesulitan dan malam-malam tanpa listrik, jadi aku menantikan akhir pekan di mana aku bisa bersantai dan bersenang-senang, tapi malam itu… Apakah ini Baek Rijin, tokoh utama novel? Ketika saya sadar kembali, saya menemukan bahwa saya berada di novel yang sedang saya baca. Apakah pegawai negeri sipil kelas tujuh sepertiku menjadi tuan muda manja dari keluarga besar Jaegal?! Karakter sampingan, yang telah menerima investasi dan cinta berlebihan sejak dia masih muda, dan sekarang sedang melalui masa badai dalam hidupnya… Tuan muda manja dari Keluarga Jaegal, yang akan dimusnahkan oleh Blood Demon Cult sepuluh tahun kemudian! ? ? ?
sinopsis_en: I achieved my cozy life of a seventh-grade civil servant by through a lot of hardships and nights of blacking out, so I was looking forward to the weekends where I could relax and have fun, but that night… Is this Baek Rijin, the main character of the novel? When I returned to my senses, I discovered I was in the novel I was reading. Did a seventh-grade civil servant like me became the spoiled young master of the great Jaegal family?! A side character, who has received excessive investments and love since he was young, and now going through a stormy period of his life… The spoiled young master of the Jaegal Family, whom the Blood Demon Cult would annihilate ten years later ! ? ? ? **Original Webtoon:** [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/59742611), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%B9%99%EC%9D%98%EA%B2%80%EC%8B%A0/2983) **Official Translations:** [S.Chinese](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/15020), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/123186)

sinopsis_id: Cerita ini mengikuti seorang mantan iblis jahat yang memutuskan untuk meninggalkan kehidupannya yang penuh kekerasan dan mengejar mimpinya menjadi seorang koki terkenal. Setelah mengalami pengkhianatan di dunia iblis, dia menemukan kedamaian dan motivasi baru di dunia manusia, khususnya di dapur yang penuh tantangan dan persaingan. Dalam perjalanan barunya, dia menghadapi berbagai rintangan termasuk prasangka dari sesama manusia, saingan yang ambisius, dan situasi sulit yang menguji keterampilan memasaknya. However, as the Heavenly Demon, there was a dream he never managed to achieve. Now, in this life, he’ll do whatever it costs to fulfil his lifelong dream of becoming a chef! This is the legendary (?) story of Cheon Woojin, the former Heavenly Demon, chasing his dreams! sinopsis_id: Villain Unrivaled mengisahkan perjuangan seorang pria yang dikenal sebagai musuh paling kuat di dunia. Setelah mengalami pengkhianatan hebat, dia bertekad untuk membangun kembali kekuatannya dan membalas dendam pada mereka yang menjatuhkannya. Dalam setiap langkahnya, dia menghadapi berbagai tantangan dan musuh yang tak kalah kuat, menguji batas kemampuan dan tekadnya. Dalam perjalanan ini, dia tidak hanya bertarung dengan fisik tetapi juga intrik dan strategi untuk mengalahkan lawan-lawannya. Cerita ini menonjolkan sisi gelap perjuangan seorang villain yang tidak hanya ingin menang, tetapi juga mengukir namanya sebagai yang terkuat dan tak terkalahkan dalam dunia penuh bahaya dan persaingan sengit.
sinopsis_en: Heli Yun, notorious degenerate, shocks everyone by suddenly turning from his lowlife ways. No one realizes he's been possessed by Lee Siwoon, the author of Heli's story! Trapped in the martial arts novel he wrote, Heli knows that unless he gains power, he's headed for a villain's death. Armed with knowledge about the novel's world, Heli sets out on a quest to gather friends and past enemies to create a martial arts force strong enough to defy the fate he was given... or literally die trying. **Original Novel**: [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/53139006), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=5137260&isWebtoonAgreePopUp=true), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/2155013346), [Joara](https://www.joara.com/book/1458619) **Original Webtoon:** [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60297218), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000075628), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13767139) **Official Translations:** [English](https://tapas.io/series/the-unrivaled-villain/info), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/130267), [T.Chinese](https://mojoin.com/comics/198)
